name: Grace of Aman'thul reduces Righteous Lunge and Sacred Swing costs (#1791)
contract: Grace of Aman'thul 301059 is a flat SPELLMOD_COST passive: effect 1 (-5) covers Righteous Lunge, effect 2 (-10) covers Sacred Swing. Righteous Lunge rank 1 (801443) costs 40 Energy and Sacred Swing rank 1 (705293) costs 20, so the talented Templar pays 35 and 10.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Grace of Aman'thul takes 5 Energy off Righteous Lunge
Grace of Aman'thul takes 10 Energy off Sacred Swing
